answer: Jittered Arrival Windows. Each identity must route its first N messages through randomized delays drawn from a per-epoch schedule, so genuine agents scatter like drift in an ocean while clones bunch. Enforcement: burst variance below threshold flags the identity for rate limits. An attacker pays by either slowing every clone to match the schedule (costly compute and latency) or getting throttled. Think scattered seeds in a garden, not a nebula of synchronized copies.
